vulnerability_analysis: The contract owner has exclusive privilege to disable the swapAndLiquify mechanism via setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false). This disrupts normal contract operations by stopping automated fee processing and liquidity additions, while the owner remains excluded from fees. This demonstrates centralization risk and owner privilege abuse.
attack_strategy: Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank() and call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable the mechanism, then verify the state change.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Get the current owner address from the contract. 2. Use vm.prank() to impersonate the owner. 3. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false). 4. Verify that swapAndLiquifyEnabled is now false.
